second_order: Remaking the subreddit as an Edmond joke
theme_note: Changing CSS, cursor, banner, vote icons and participant labels into an Edmond-centered April Fools display; members vary between making and explaining the display, disabling it, enjoying it, and condemning it.

second_order: Posting freely for the day and policing the jokes
theme_note: Using a temporarily loosened posting boundary to publish fake news, memes, fanfiction and recycled formats, while other members explain the date and judge quality, cruelty and acceptable limits.

second_order: Proposing an r/place mark without yet making it
theme_note: Calling for a pixel Edmond, PRIDE mark, or member-led participation and sometimes receiving encouragement, but not yet supplying a workable target, coordinates, placement report, or completion.

second_order: Cross-posting a Rizin matchup amid the joke
theme_note: A single ordinary Rizin matchup cross-post shares no demonstrated practice with the interface joke, free-posting day, or canvas proposals, so it remains a one-code theme.

second_order: Picturing what everyone in the sub looks like
theme_note: Taking up a shared image as a collective self-caricature, varying it through fitness and neckbeard jokes and then branching into serious body and weight-loss accounts.

second_order: Ending, preserving and looking back on shitpost day
theme_note: Marking the joke day as ending, preserving screenshots and styling memories, promising recurrence, squeezing in last posts, turning one into a reunion, enforcing the cutoff, and rejecting a late joke; reactions remain divided.

second_order: Building, bargaining for and holding an r/MMA mark
theme_note: Turning freed Canadian space into a planned and then participant-claimed r/MMA mark through site and image choice, templates, coordinates, teaching, pixel work, diplomacy, conflict and defense; participants vary between leading, placing, learning, dissenting and negotiating.
regrouped_from: Preparing a UFC-logo build in freed Canadian space

second_order: Recounting the small logo as a shared achievement
theme_note: Thanking participants, reconstructing work and alliances, allocating credit, explaining space constraints, celebrating survival, and criticizing the result after placement ended.
